name: reverser
description: Evidence-driven Android, Flutter AOT, and native reverse engineering with the local offline runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze Android and native binaries safely
interface.longDescription: Analyze APK/DEX with Droid ASC or isolated JADX, recover Flutter Dart AOT objects and API contracts, and inspect native binaries through loopback Ghidra MCP with explicit capability checks.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this APK and record reproducible evidence.
Trace this JNI boundary into the native library.
Inspect this binary through headless Ghidra.
